messages:
lara: Heads-up: QA reported some weird negatives in the per-model cost hovercard after we rolled out sampled telemetry for low-traffic routes. Example: model=redwood-lite, route=/summarize, sample_rate=0.002 -> hover shows -$0.08 cache savings which obviously looks wrong.
maria: that usually means warmup amortization > observed prefetched hits because n is tiny.
rajiv: yep. our formula is: savings = observed_hit_rate * avg_prefetched_tokens * unit_cost - warmup_amortized. with very small n observed_hit_rate is noisy and variance dominates.
ben: console currently expects a point estimate. backend should return richer payload: estimate, sample_count, ci95_low, ci95_high, source (live|rollup|suppressed), method (analytic|bootstrap|rollup).
tessa: UX idea: show point + small line "n=XX, 95% CI: [$L, $H]". If n<ROLLUP_MIN show "Insufficient samples" and a CTA: "View 7d rollup".
sophie: also surface quota hint: if tenant throttle_rate > 0.2 show banner "Quota may limit samples  calculations biased".
lara: thresholds proposal: ROLLUP_MIN=30, LIVE_MIN=100 configurable per org. default ROLLUP_MIN=30.
ben: backend plan: analytic ci via delta-method for common routes (cheap), fallback to precomputed bootstrap from daily rollup for high-variance routes. choose live vs rollup by sample_count. add header X-Rollup-Used: true/false and X-Sample-Window: 7d.
rajiv: add feature-flagged query param `force_live_estimate=true` (audited) for debuggers. console should log when user forces live.
tessa: implementation notes: analytic std_err approx: std_err = sqrt(h*(1-h)/n) * toks_per_hit * unit_cost; ci95 = estimate +- 1.96*std_err. include warning if toks_per_hit variance large.
ben: I'll open PR feat/hover-stats-v2 with schema and tests. will include `source` field and advisory_message.
maria: please include sample_count and CI so SREs stop opening tickets. link PR when ready so we can validate with the tenant that filed the ticket.
sophie: console: render thin translucent CI band in hovercard sparkline. if source==rollup show clock icon + tooltip "24h rollup". suppressed -> show dash and CTA.
ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary deploy for telemetry-hover-v2 in 10m :rocket:
lara: great. after canary I'll validate negative-case tickets and confirm the UX avoids alarming customers. thanks all :raised_hands:
